incident-bot: ALERT: GPU_POOL_EVICT_THRESHOLD exceeded in eu-west-1 (pool: rwd-eu-gpu-03). Queue growth observed > 1200 pending requests. Paging sam (oncall).

sam (oncall): I'm on it. seeing 500+ new queue items over last 5m, average token latency spiking. Is autoscaler responding?

maria (sre): Looks like the horizontal autoscaler hit scale_limit=48 gpus for that shard. Metrics show scale-up requests queued and provider returning delayed completions. Investigating provider-side throttles.

josh (runtime): Confirmed: we pushed canary kernel update 2h ago, but runtime health is fine for existing nodes. Autoscaler logs show repeated 429s from cloud API starting ~1769997600.

sam (oncall): Customer impact? any 5xx or throttled requests hitting customers?

ellen (support): Several customers reported increased latencies and small % of generation failures. I've flagged three paying accounts (acct-A, acct-B, acct-C) to AE. No data exfiltration.

maria (sre): Short-term mitigation: we can enable graceful shed + promote fallback model (quantized instance) for bursty routes. Recommend toggle route-level fallback for top 10 affected tenants.

josh (runtime): Rolling fallback now for /v1/generate on model redwood-large-1 -> redwood-large-1-quant. Command: ```/deploy fallback --route /v1/generate --from redwood-large-1 --to redwood-large-1-quant --scope tenant:top10``` Will run in a minute.

sam (oncall): Proceed. Also open a provider support ticket re: API 429s. Maria, can you confirm scale_limit config and whether we can temporarily raise it?

maria (sre): We've got soft_limit=48, hard_limit=64. Hard limit requires approvals; we can patch cluster manager to allow short-lived burst to hard_limit for 30m. I'm patching now: ```kubectl patch config autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"hard_limit":64}}'``` will push in ~90s.

ops-rotation: FYI — queue draining will still take time due to long-tail sequences. Consider prefix caching evictions to free KV.

max (devex): I'm broadcasting status to status.redwood.ai and adding an explanation to the developer console about temporary degraded throughput.

sam (oncall): Patch deployed?

maria (sre): Patch applied. Provider ticket opened (TICKET-98765). Provider confirms control-plane rate limiting on create VM APIs, ETA unknown.

josh (runtime): Fallback rollout succeeded for top tenants. We saw immediate 20-40% drop in latency for those routes. Queue growth rate reduced from +800/min to +120/min within 6m.

ellen (support): Noted customers responding that errors dropped. Still some queued work for lower-tier tenants. Any plan for those?

maria (sre): Next step: start on-call schedule for controlled eviction of low-priority jobs and enable tenant-based rate caps for 15m windows. I will run an eviction job: ```/ops evict --selector priority=low --max=2000 --dry-run=false```

sam (oncall): Please include logs of evicted job ids so we can notify customers in the AM. Also keep me updated on provider ticket.

incident-bot: BRIDGE CALL created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1769997777 (auto-joined by oncall).

lina (product): Quick note — prioritize paying tenants for mitigation paths. We should avoid manual tenant evictions for paid contracts unless necessary. Any paid tenants in eviction list?

maria (sre): Eviction job excluded paid tenants via selector `account_tier!=paid`. Will only target non-paid or best-effort lanes.

sam (oncall): Good. Current status: autoscaler bumped hard_limit, fallback rollout succeeded for top routes, eviction started for low-priority jobs, provider ticket open. Queue length: 430 pending, trending down. Estimated time to normal < 25m if provider accepts scale requests; otherwise we continue graceful degrade.

josh (runtime): Adding a mitigations checklist for the postmortem: 1) provider rate-limit handling hardened in autoscaler; 2) safer automatic fallback ordering per tenant; 3) better early-warning (queue derivative alert) and 4) one-click temporary hard_limit toggle with audit.

maria (sre): Action items (short): [AI-1] revert canary if correlated to increased load (josh) [AI-2] add provider 429 exponential backoff + circuit breaker (maria) [AI-3] document tenant eviction playbook and notify support (sam + ellen) [AI-4] evaluate default soft/hard limits and escalation path (ops rotation + infra).

sam (oncall): I'll create the incident ticket and schedule a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow 11:00 UTC. Please add notes to the bridge. We will run RCA and assign owners.

ellen (support): I'll prepare customer messages for acct-A/B/C and a canned status for status page.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: queue stabilized below 250 pending at 1769997830. No active paging. Marking for postmortem.

sam (oncall): Great work team. Add any logs/screenshots to the incident doc. Closing thread — will follow up in PM for postmortem writeup.
